theorem lg_target (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (h : x + y = 2) : x * y ≤ 1 := by
  have h_sum : x + y = 2 := h
  have h_ave : (x + y) / 2 = 1 := by rw [h_sum, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_one]
  have h_geometric : √(x * y) ≤ 1 :=
    Real.sqrt_le_left (by linarith) (by rw [h_ave, le_rfl])
  exact sq_le_of_le_sqrt (by linarith) h_geometric
